_comment: Task 2 additional training positives: useful text screens with only a screen, whiteboard or document and no people. Strengthens the 'screen text means record' signal and decouples it from 'there is a person in frame'. This is the positive side of the comparison the advisor specified.
_label: category=positive, which prepare_dataset maps to label 1 (record). Each new slug becomes a subclass under positive.
_scope: Strictly inside the MVP launch positive definition: projector, computer screen text, slides, whiteboard, document page, code screen. Deliberately unpeopled, forming a contrast pair with neg_people that breaks the spurious 'people implies record' correlation.
_distinct: The concepts differ from the existing positive subclasses rather than being synonyms, so they do not return the same batch of Pexels images. Global ID dedup catches anything that slips through.
_manual_qc: After downloading, remove any image with people clearly in frame, such as a speaker or an audience. Those belong to the held-out person-plus-screen probe, not to the unpeopled positives.
